short: The world's oldest central bank, founded by the Swedish parliament.
full:
Established in 1668 by the Riksdag of the Estates, the Riksens Ständers Bank (later renamed Sveriges Riksbank) is the oldest central bank in the world. It was created in the aftermath of the collapse of the Stockholm Banco, the first European bank to issue banknotes.

To restore public confidence in the financial system, the new bank was placed under the direct control of the parliament rather than the crown. The institution successfully stabilized the Swedish currency and provided reliable credit mechanisms, serving as a critical financial foundation for the state apparatus and the broader economy.
